title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v4.8.0 release.

v4.8.0 carries the source-only layers recorded after the v4.7.0 release (v4.7.0-r85 to r94) and opens the v4.8.0 line with the Planck-Readout Metric Layer (v4.8.0-r01).

Post-v4.7.0 layers: citation repair and unity-theorem scope separation (r85); C5 asymptotic-collar bookkeeping with the threshold function n_min(theta) and the finite-zero exclusion for any multiplicative collar recursion with q > 0 (r86); photon-clock selector-window calibration and its correction (r87, r89); admissibility test for non-collar routes, excluding the subtractive channel and truncation and leaving only a non-collar witness open (r88); an approximate reconstruction of the bound Delta_gamma < 1/5 (r90), sharpened into an exact one: 1/5 is the minimal admissible relative drop over the primary relay chain, attained at chart V3 (r92); execution of the C4 mixed-kernel branch Q4, showing that beta_4 = 1/256 cannot be spent under matter-frame typing (r91); the two-sided tensor typing read as a routing grammar (r93); and the provenance of the C5 contraction factor 3/4, recorded as a declared ledger value whose detector stage n = 20 fixes q only to an interval (r94).

v4.8.0-r01 defines a readout-calibrated Planck scale l_eff(R) = l_P lambda_R with an orientation code, recovers the matter-frame Planck scale up to a declared calibration error, identifies the photon-frame Planck length as an instance, and separates the orientation code from the r82 tachyon-frame interval signature. The MM/HC field-equation refactor of this research line is not performed in this release.

Scope guard: this is a guarded local/restricted/effective release. Guard and residual vectors are unchanged from v4.7.0. It does not claim exact finite C5 zero closure, exact all-readout terminality, C6/T2 closure, a global photon-clock or Riemann-Hypothesis theorem, global all-readout closure, or a negative physical length.
